data.one_liner: A portable Markdown library written in Dart that can parse Markdown into HTML.
data.what_it_does: Parses Markdown text into HTML on both the client and server. Supports multiple extension sets such as CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown, as well as custom syntax extensions.
use_when: You need to parse Markdown documents into HTML in a Dart or Flutter application.
You want support for CommonMark or GitHub Flavored Markdown extension sets.
avoid_when: You need built-in HTML sanitization out of the box.
You are looking for a Markdown widget for rendering rich text natively rather than via HTML.
strengths: Portable and works on both client and server.
Supports multiple pre-defined extension sets like CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown.
Allows creating and using custom syntax extensions.
weaknesses: Offers no features in the way of HTML sanitization.
Requires manual handling of XSS vulnerabilities via sanitization.
